kickoff_context: Ran immediately after the session where voice became FOUNDER-CONFIRMED for the first time (a real mix played in #Bollywood_House), and after the launcher bug that had stopped the bot starting at all was found and fixed. The listening rooms are real as of today, which is what unblocks most of tonight's bundle.
founder_lenses: CONSUMER: a person arrives in Discord wanting an INSTANT mix. Two places to make one - the #get-shit-done text channel, and the listening (voice) rooms. Judge every change by what that person feels.
FOUNDER: maximum convenience for the user, but ZERO money to spend. At every blockage, reason from first principles to a FREE solution.

decisions.the_station: RE-PLAY PAST MIXES, BEST-FIRST. When a room's queue empties it must NOT go silent - it becomes a radio of what the community has already made, ordered favouring mixes people reacted to with fire. Costs no Replicate credit and no new disk, and it makes the reaction data load-bearing. Explicitly NOT auto-grinding fresh pairs on idle (burns credits and disk with nobody necessarily listening).
decisions.the_station_hard_constraint: THE BOT STILL NEVER JUDGES A MIX. Ordering by human reactions is allowed because those are the community's votes, not Grinder's opinion. But the station must NEVER announce a ranking, call a mix good, show a score, or say anything that reads as a verdict. Silent ordering only. Violating this prejudices the fire/skull/neutral reaction data, which is the real product signal.
decisions.playback_controls: ANYONE IN THE ROOM can skip or stop. Matches how small friendly Discord rooms actually behave, and at validation scale social pressure handles abuse. Deliberately NOT a skip-vote (fiddly and silly with two people) and NOT owner-only (a bad mix whose owner has left would hold the room for three minutes).
decisions.hosting_research: HARD ZERO BUDGET. Research genuinely FREE always-on options only, and report honestly on what they can and cannot run - including a straight answer on whether free is possible at all for an always-on bot + engine. No paid comparison shopping. Research only; NO code, NO migration, NO signing up for anything.
decisions.windows_disk_reclaim: YES - reclaim Windows Update's 7.81 GB download cache plus our own temp/scratch junk, using Windows' own supported cleanup. Found at kickoff: free disk fell 9.28 -> 5.86 GB during the session and Prompt-DJ was NOT the cause (its data folder was unchanged; the founder's test grinds added only 0.51 GB).
decisions.listening_data: RECORD WHO, WHEN, AND HOW LONG. Discord user id, join time, leave time, and which mix was playing. This is the founder's own server and own members, and it is the minimum that answers 'do people actually listen, and when do they drop off' - the two data gaps recorded as blocking the Discord community phase. Deliberately NOT also linking reactions to individuals this round (more personal data than the question needs).
decisions.catalog_sweep: RUN IT LAST, CLEAN-AS-YOU-GO. 134 pairs remain of 216. Each render is deleted once judged so disk never accumulates. If it runs out of time or space it PARKS HONESTLY with partial results - partial coverage is still useful, a disk-starved machine reporting false 'bad pair' verdicts is not.
decisions.events_db_cleanup: YES - clear the placeholder and load-test rows so real numbers are not polluted. Back the file up first and report exactly how many rows went.

hard_constraints: DANGEROUS surfaces are STAGED, never self-applied overnight (ZUKO_OVERNIGHT). Nothing in tonight's bundle is expected to need one - the janitor was deliberately REDESIGNED to leave services/api/app/storage.py byte-identical.

services/api/app/storage.py MUST NOT be modified. The janitor is a NEW file that calls the existing sweep(target_free_gb=...) and sweep(dry_run=True), both of which already exist. If a task appears to require editing storage.py, STOP and stage it instead.
workers/render.py and services/api/app/planner/validate.py must NOT be modified. Nothing tonight changes how a mix SOUNDS.
Never weaken, skip or delete a test to make code pass.
The 0.03s cache hit is a protected product property - no change may regress it.
Free only. No paid service, no cloud spend, no new subscription, no sign-ups.
The bot never judges a mix - see the_station_hard_constraint.
Nothing merges to main. One integration branch, one morning PR.
